question: Does TRAIN teacher-gold top1 agreement gated KL improve a 0.5B student over identically trained gold-SFT on a new project-context holdout?
hypothesis_basis: Observed TRAIN agreement 1141/1289 supervised positions; historical reused dev full-KD underperformed gold-SFT. No new cohort prediction or score used to select this single candidate.

training.optimizer: AdamW default betas and eps; weight_decay=0.01
training.gated_kd_objective: 0.5*CE + 0.5*T^2*sum(teacher argmax == gold ? token KL : 0)/N; N is ALL supervised positions
training.teacher_cache: Regenerate once from strict verified local teacher/student bytes; complete-vocabulary fp16 log probabilities; no legacy cache. Gold arm validates same cache but does not optimize KL.

data.selection: Frozen hash order with round-robin articles, after historical exact-context/question and near-question exclusions; fail if insufficient. No model outcome filtering.
data.input_label_separation: inputs.jsonl has no answers/is_impossible; labels file is not read by prediction process; all nine predictions must be completed and hash-locked before scoring. This is an auditable process boundary, not cryptographic blinding.
data.independence: New to audited project model evaluation at context level, not unseen articles, hidden official SQuAD test, random production traffic, or known pretraining-clean data. Five accidentally displayed articles are excluded in full.

scoring.metric: qa_lab.metrics SQuAD-style normalized EM/token F1, exact NO_ANSWER; format validity reported separately. Not official SQuAD script.
scoring.primary: mean across seeds gated_kd minus gold overall EM; full_kd secondary, cannot replace primary
scoring.confidence: 95% percentile paired article-cluster bootstrap on per-question seed-mean paired differences, question-weighted across resampled articles. Captures cohort/article sampling, not full training-seed uncertainty.
scoring.acceptance: All: gain>=0.03; bootstrap lower>0; >=2 seeds gain>0; answerable and unanswerable mean drops<=0.02; each candidate seed format_valid_rate>=0.99. No rounding before decisions.

generation.warmup_input: Synthetic fixed queue FIFO question from existing inference code, no cohort labels
generation.timing_scope: Cost accounting only, not a latency/throughput benchmark; includes serial offline generation without request scheduling.

order.prediction: Same nine-run order, fixed inputs file order; train and freeze all nine adapters before any heldout predictions.

budget.models: Existing verified local snapshots only; no downloads, conversions, API or model uploads

failure_policy: Stop on hash/coverage/token alignment/non-finite/timing/memory/disk failure. Preserve partial output and failure receipt. Never overwrite/rerun a completed arm, replace inputs or lower thresholds. Runtime/code failures require documented new execution version before retry; holdout scores are never used for tuning.
limitations: Gate changes both which KL targets contribute and total KL strength; no causal isolation of teacher disagreement.
One candidate, one finite cohort, three seeds; failure or inconclusive result is retained.
All three arms are the same student size. This study tests soft-target quality benefit, not quantization success, teacher quality parity, inference speedup or production readiness.
Legacy dev and historical results remain unchanged; no external quality confirmation retroactively applied to them.
